tools.name: municipality_search
tools.description: Finds Swiss municipalities by name fragment or postcode. Returns the BFS id, name, canton and postcodes for each match. The BFS id is the key every other tool here takes.

tools.name: tax_lookup
tools.description: Calculates the annual Swiss income tax for one municipality and one household profile, split into federal, cantonal and municipal parts. The figures come from the federal tax administration's calculation for the given gross income.

tools.name: municipality_detail
tools.description: Returns the tax picture for one municipality relative to a stated current home: the annual difference, the tax multiplier, and the multi-year trend where past years are known.

tools.name: favorable_municipalities
tools.description: Ranks municipalities that are cheaper than, or within CHF 1000/yr of, a stated current home, by annual tax saving — municipalities near-identical in cost are included deliberately, not filtered out. Answered from cached figures only, so the ranking may be partial; the response states how many candid

tools.name: listing_search
tools.description: Lists apartments currently advertised in one municipality, cheapest first, with the local median asking rent. Indicative figures for browsing only: they come from a portal feed and are not verified against the listing page.

tools.name: commute_time
tools.description: Returns the public-transport journey time in minutes between two Swiss places, using the national timetable.

tools.name: commute_cost
tools.description: Estimates the monthly cost in CHF of commuting between two Swiss places, as a transit-pass estimate priced from Swiss regional fare-zone data. Some pricing regimes are approximations rather than an exact tariff.

tools.name: rent_benchmark
tools.description: Reports the Swiss Federal Statistical Office's average monthly rent for a municipality, optionally for a given apartment size in rooms. findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "favorable_municipalities" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Ranks municipalities that are cheaper than, or within CHF 1000/yr of, a stated current home, by annual tax saving — municipalities near-identical in cost are in…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: listing_search · Public sink: rent_benchmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: listing_search · Public sink: rent_benchmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
